description: Update a stopped/paused agent's generated strategy reference, name, cadence, risk limits, or server-monitored exits while retaining its UUID and history. Strategy revisions require a proven-flat position book and cannot resume in the same request; review the returned strategy hash, then resume separately.

acknowledge_unvalidated.description: Explicitly acknowledge missing or degraded replay evidence for a live strategy revision.

budget_usd.description: Updated capital ceiling; cannot exceed the live key cap or approved portfolio envelope.

clear_exit_plan.description: Remove every server-monitored exit rule. Cannot be combined with individual exit-plan fields.

confirmed_budget_usd.description: Exact reviewed capital, required for live budget increases.

cycle_seconds.description: Updated cadence. Polymarket minimum 5s; other venues 30s.

expected_current_strategy_sha256.description: Optional current-strategy hash to bind the reviewed revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Auto-generated when omitted.

max_daily_loss_usd.description: Exact daily-loss ceiling, or null to turn this named agent limit off.

max_position_usd.description: Exact position ceiling, or null to turn this named agent limit off.

replay_attestation.description: Replay attestation token for this exact replacement strategy.

resume.description: Restart the same agent after updating its policy.

stop_loss_pct.description: Optional live hard-stop fraction for venues with server-monitored exits.

strategy_id.description: Optional owned Felix-generated replacement strategy UUID. The agent must be stopped and have no open positions.

name: update_agent
